name: Apify
description: Apify is a powerful, scalable platform designed to automate web scraping, data extraction, and web automation tasks effortlessly. Whether you need to collect data from websites, automate repetitive browser actions, or build complex workflows, Apify provides a robust, developer-friendly environment to make it happen, without sacrificing flexibility or control.
